title: Valuing a Bank Deposit Shortfall When the Partner Rate Departs from the Locked Rate
content:
When an incorrect amount on a Bank Deposit transfer is valued in US dollars, the valuation rate depends on how far the rate the payout partner actually applied fell from the transfer's locked exchange rate, together with the level of the customer's Personal Sender Account.

## Records read

- The transfer's locked exchange rate.
- The rate the latest payout applied: the exchange rate recorded on the latest payout-sent entry of the transfer's ledger.
- The current level of the customer's Personal Sender Account.

## Clause

The partner rate gap is the locked exchange rate less the rate the latest payout applied, as a percentage of the locked exchange rate. When the partner rate gap is at least 2 percent and the customer's Personal Sender Account is at Paloma Verified Plus or above (level number 3 or higher), the valuation rate is the rate the latest payout applied; when the partner rate gap is at least 2 percent and the account is below Paloma Verified Plus (level number 1 or 2), the valuation rate is the average of the locked exchange rate and the rate the latest payout applied; when the partner rate gap is below 2 percent, this rule does not apply.

| Partner rate gap | Personal Sender Account level | Valuation rate |
|---|---|---|
| 2 percent or more | Paloma Verified Plus or above (3 or higher) | the rate the latest payout applied |
| 2 percent or more | Paloma Starter or Paloma Verified (1 or 2) | the average of the locked rate and the rate the latest payout applied |
| below 2 percent | any | not affected by this rule |

## Worked case (hypothetical rates)

Locked exchange rate 18.3243; the latest payout applied 17.8000.

1. Gap: 18.3243 less 17.8000 is 0.5243; 0.5243 as a percentage of 18.3243 is about 2.86 percent, which is at least 2 percent.
2. Customer at Paloma Enhanced (level 4): valuation rate 17.8000.
3. Customer at Paloma Verified (level 2): valuation rate is the average of 18.3243 and 17.8000, that is 18.06215.

**At the threshold.** A gap of exactly 2 percent is "at least 2 percent", so the rule applies. A locked rate of 20.0000 and an applied rate of 19.6000 give exactly 2 percent; an applied rate of 19.6100 gives 1.95 percent and the rule does not apply.
